pages.text: There are a lot of ways to power diagrams, but at first you have no choice but to drain your $(bold)Self$(): the essence that makes you $(italic)you$() and keeps you going. It follows that depositing it in a diagram has... adverse effects. You will recover some Self each sunrise, and regain all of it when you get an Advancement.

To place some of your Self in a diagram, crouch-right-click an item focus with an empty hand. Item foci can hold up to 7 Self.$(br2)Self is a versatile power source, and will attempt to power any focus it influences.
